destination.method: Binary nonblack static-pixel registration excludes HUD, Mario, vine and moving six-orb platform rows. Exact cloud-floor tile136 fixes every horizontal phase; steady rightward walking is constrained to measured1.5px/native-frame±2px per checkpoint. Supplied atlas RGB establishes static metatiles. Additional coin palette phases are measured as observed orange8/9-by-14 connected pixel components at rows5/6/11, snapped to their nearest16px grid cell with screenshot witnesses. No hidden cells are synthesized.
uncertainties: World camera coordinates are inferred from screenshot alignment and a measured walking-speed bound; repetitive rows can admit multiple equal binary alignments, recorded per checkpoint.
Coin artwork can differ by one horizontal pixel between scroll/animation phases. Coin grid positions use the nearest cell; component bounds and observation counts are retained.
Non-atlas floating cloud artwork remains explicit unknown cells rather than invented collision geometry.
Vine and moving six-orb platform are dynamic and are not encoded as static tiles.
Only the ordinary cloud-floor walking route was observed. Riding the platform and collecting the high coins remain unmeasured.
Width is the observed viewport extent, not an inferred unseen room boundary.
